high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "cr7cristianoronaldo," which belongs to Cristiano Ronaldo. The post was made 4 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The main focus of the image is a pair of glasses with a tortoiseshell pattern, featuring a classic round frame design. The text "HAVANA STYLE" is prominently displayed above the glasses, suggesting that the glasses are inspired by or associated with the Havana style.
